summary_en: First dividend in company history: ¥7.00/share (full-year FY12/26). New dividend policy: progressive (no cuts absent losses); future dividends pegged to DOE (dividend-on-equity) 3%+ floor. Shift to shareholder payout phase following improved profitability and stable financial foundation.
title_en: Notice regarding variance between H1 FY12/26 earnings forecast and actual results, full-year earnings forecast revision upward, and dividend policy change with initial dividend forecast revision
translation_en_brief:
Atlas Technologies disclosed its first dividend in company history on 14 August 2026. Following upward revision of full-year FY12/26 earnings (operating profit raised to ¥100M from ¥60M, net income to ¥70M from ¥40M), the board adopted a new dividend policy with immediate effect.

The company will pay ¥7.00 per share as a full-year dividend for FY12/26 (no interim distribution). Under the new policy, the company commits to "progressive dividend" discipline: dividends are maintained or increased in line with profit growth, with no cuts absent extraordinary loss. A dividend-on-equity (DOE) floor of 3% or above will guide all future dividend decisions, anchoring payouts to shareholders' equity rather than earnings volatility from one-time M&A or new ventures.

The company justified the policy shift by citing achievement of "continuous profit creation", stabilized financial foundation, and clear medium-term growth visibility—marking its transition from a retention-first phase to a shareholder-return phase.
